name: RMAC Cross Country Championships
headline: RMAC: Adams State men and Western Colorado women win titles
summary: Adams State won the men’s title with 33 points to No. 2 Colorado School of Mines’ 48, with No. 9 Western Colorado third (79) and UC-Colorado Springs fourth (107). Mines’ Dawson Gunn won the men’s 8K in 23:17.3. In the women’s race, No. 5 Western Colorado won with 40 points over No. 1 Adams State (55), UC-Colorado Springs (64) and No. 3 Mines (69); Mines’ Emily LaMena took the individual title in 20:38.2.
